name: Moonflower
body:
[Source: GB19]

Moonflower develops into webs of sensory filaments that cause synesthesia, and they let the user sense psychic emanations and focus their own psychokinetic energy into a powerful attack.

DETAIL

Type injury (injected); Addiction minor, Fortitude DC 15; Price 135 gp

EFFECT

3 hours; +1 alchemical bonus to Intimidate checks and light blindness. During this time, gain detect thoughts and mind thrust I as spell-like abilities (CL 4th), each usable once.

DAMAGE

1d3 Wisdom damage
